target_customer: B2B sales teams running outbound prospecting
problem: Outbound prospecting is manual and noisy; Topo's agent finds leads from buying signals, drafts messages and books meetings.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus outbound consulting

founders.name: Dan Elkaim
founders.background_notes: YC page: about 10 years in B2B SaaS sales.

founders.name: Léonard Henriquez
education: Business school graduate and Master's in AI (institutions not named)

founders.name: Robin Philibert
founders.background_notes: Described as COO on the company about page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Signal detection, enrichment, sequencing and deliverability are many integrations on top of LLM drafting; no research level problem.

defensibility.rationale: CRM integrations help, but many AI SDR tools such as 11x and Artisan sell the same promise.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; many AI SDR competitors emerged in 2024 and 2025.

market_need_then: Founders saw outbound demand at Aircall; the company claims 150+ customers and 200+ teams (self reported on its site).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, problem versus solution headlines

rebrands.from: Capsule (earlier digital sales room product, per CB Insights)
rebrands.why: Not stated; launch of AI outbound agents with pre-seed.

branding.community_and_virality: Company claims 4.9/5 rating and 20+ G2 badges (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but shared with many unrelated Topo products; no brand press found.

pivots.why: Launch post announces AI agents for outbound with the pre-seed; the rationale is not detailed in sources opened.

outcome_analysis: Topo pivoted from a digital sales room to AI outbound agents in 2023, raised a roughly one million euro pre-seed and joined YC in Winter 2024. It claims 150+ customers, but the AI SDR category is crowded with better known players, and no later round is confirmed, so the outcome is open.
notes: Pre-seed is stated as 1 million euros; USD not recorded to avoid a self computed conversion. A $500K YC convertible note in April 2024 appears only on aggregators (CB Insights, Extruct) so is unverified; one aggregator claims $46M total, rejected as an outlier. Competitor results were 2025 and 2026 vendor posts, not dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Founded year 2023 per most sources; two list 2022. Competition list empty: no sources dated near the batch were found.
